step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the earnings issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — earnings.”
Details: Document the decision and justification according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Indicate the earnings type. There could be more than one earnings type.
Explain the allocation of the earnings in relation to EIR 35 , EIR 36 and Digest 5 — Earnings . EIR 35 EIR 36 Digest 5 — Earnings
Explain that the FWW code needs to be removed for some weeks, if necessary.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 3.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
Under Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 3.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 9.

step.cmd: Determine if the FWW code needs to be changed in any of the reports under investigation:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.
If no, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In FTS, on the Payment Tab, select the appropriate Report week and modify the claimant’s report as follows: * Change only the information that requires modification .

ul.li: Select Modify . Note
Earnings: For each week, type the client’s earnings if necessary.

Full work week: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Full work week - week 1
2 - Full work week - week 2
3 - Full work week both weeks
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Select Save .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if earnings need to be modified on weeks where the FWW code does not need to be changed.

ul.li: If yes, go to step 6.
If no, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction and input the earnings as follows (if necessary, refer to the ROD and the Earnings procedure or to Digest 5 — Earnings to help you determine how to allocate the earnings):

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Type: Select A - Amended earnings :
Amount: Enter the amount indicated on the Report of Interview.
Start date: Enter the Sunday of the first week of the earnings to correct.
End date: Enter the appropriate option:
If many consecutive weeks have the same amount to allocate, enter the Saturday of the last week of that series.
If there are no consecutive weeks, enter the Saturday of that week.
Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If there are many consecutive weeks and the amount of the last week is different from the start amount, enter that amount.
If the amount from the last week is the same, leave the field blank.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number
D - No to leave the registration number open
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if an MA is imposed to stop payments for the unreported earnings:

ul.li: If an MA is imposed, go to step 8.

If an MA is not imposed, in FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to complete the registration number as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update
Go to step 22.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA.
Rescind: Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes to clear the registration number.
Select Update .
Go to step 22.

step.cmd: Determine if the FWW code must be changed in any of the reports under investigation:

ul.li: If no FWW code must be changed, go to step 10.
If a FWW code must be changed for a week of regular benefits, go to step 10.
If a FWW code must be changed for a week of special benefits, go to step 20.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 2.
If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 11.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 20.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 12.
If all rows are blank, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 12.
If all rows are blank, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the earnings to be input varies and requires an input on a weekly basis:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 16.
If no, and the amount to input requires a weekly allocation amount, go to step 17.

step.cmd: Under the Allocation "A" tab, in the Amended Earnings column, input the amended earnings as follows:

ul.li:
Select the week that requires a change. Repeat for every week that requires a change.
Amended earnings: Type the new amount of earnings.
FWW: Select the new FWW code (if a change is needed).
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Select Update .
Go to step 18.

step.cmd: Under the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select the appropriate allocation type.
Amount: Enter the amount allocated per week.
Start date: Enter the start date of the allocation.
End date: Enter the end date of the allocation or 9999 if the end date is indefinite.

Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the normal weekly earnings, enter that amount.
If the allocation amount in the last week is equal to the normal weekly earnings, leave the box empty.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment.
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 19.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 22.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 15 .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (SMP): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim related to the correction of earnings. Note

If the amended reports will create an OP, do the following:
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .

If the amended reports will create an UP, do the following:
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .

Earnings to be allocated:
Week: Select the weeks indicated on the Report of Investigation for which the salary must be corrected.
Amount: Enter the amount indicated on the Report of Investigation for each concerned week.
Remarks line 1: Enter the information regarding the modification of the FWW code, if necessary.
Remarks line 2: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the case involves more than 52 weeks of unreported earnings:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 23.
If no, go to step 24. Note

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)
Various reasons for penalty and violation (2935): Select Blank .

Some or all earnings, Self-Employment Earnings or Fishing Earnings not declared / omitted (2953)
Did not declare any or some earnings / earnings from self-employment
According to our records / In addition, according to our records (2936)
did not declare any earnings / declared only some earnings (2955): Select the appropriate option.
Text - Type of earnings (1072)
Text field: Employer name or Source of Earnings / Self Employment (2956)
Blank / based on new information you provided / based on new information your employer provided (2958)
List of one or more false declarations (3483)
Dates of Weeks comparing Actual vs Declared Earnings (1494)

$0.00 - Actual earnings amounts (1492)
Ex: 500 for $500.00
Ex: 492 for $492.00
$0.00 - Earnings declared by claimant (1490)
Claim possibly affected / claim not affected (2957)
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Levels of misrepresentation (12292): Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment .
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim .
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim .
This Letter Replaces or Footnote (2365): Select Footnote .

Text – Footnote (11745): Type “This letter includes only the information related to the benefit period starting on [BPC date]. The information related to the benefit period starting on [BPC date] is included on a separate letter.”

Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim .
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim .

step.cmd: In NIIS, from the Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li:
Overpayment: Select the appropriate option:
OP for an overpayment
UP for an underpayment
Reason: Select Allocation of Earnings .
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity WI.
